properties.title: Flood Advisory issued July 23 at 5:15AM EDT until July 23 at 10:00AM EDT by NWS Raleigh NC
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive and repetitive rainfall is
expected.

* WHERE...A portion of central North Carolina, including the
following counties, Chatham, Durham, Granville, Orange, Person,
Vance and Wake.

* WHEN...Until 1000 AM EDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas,
urban areas, and near small creeks and streams.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 508 AM EDT, Doppler radar and automated rain gauges
indicate that between 1 and 3 inches of rain has fallen
across parts of the area. While the rain has fallen over a
long period of time, additional heavy rain could result in
minor flooding in the advisory area.
- Additional rainfall amounts of 1 to 3 inches are expected
over the area. This additional rain will result in minor
flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Raleigh, Durham, Cary, Chapel Hill, Henderson, Oxford,
Hillsborough, Creedmoor, Carrboro, Butner, Morrisville, Stem,
Middleburg, and Bahama.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.
